component.name: InitialFocusScene
component.script:
Function init() m.top.setFocus(true) printFocusTree(m.top) End Function
Function onKeyEvent(key, press) print "InitialFocusScene.onKeyEvent key = "; key if press ' Testing initialFocus with/without initialFocus and with/without setFocus calls if key = "up" print "Replacing children with 'GroupFocus' and setting focus" replaceChild("GroupFocus", true) return true else if key = "left" print "Replacing children with 'GroupFocus' without setting focus" replaceChild("GroupFocus", false) return true else if key = "down" print "Replacing children with 'GroupNoFocus' and setting focus" replaceChild("GroupNoFocus", true) return true else if key = "right" print "Replacing children with 'GroupNoFocus' without setting focus" replaceChild("GroupNoFocus", false) return true
' For testing moving focus up/down a parent/child chain else if key = "fastforward" ' testing moving child = m.top.getChild(0) child.setFocus(true) else if key = "rewind" m.top.setFocus(true)
' Testing reused nodes and how initialFocus affects focus else if key = "back" ' Remove and append the current child to see how initialFocus is affected print "Removing and replacing current child" child = m.top.getChild(0) m.top.removeChild(child) m.top.appendChild(child) child.setFocus(true) return true end if end if printFocusTree(m.top) return false End Function
Function replaceChild(subType, focus) m.top.removeChildrenIndex(m.top.getChildCount(), 0) child = m.top.createChild(subType) if focus child.setFocus(true) end if End Function
' Recursively print the focus tree Function printFocusTree(node, level=0) indent = "" for i=0 to level indent = indent + " " end for ' self print indent + "<"; node.subtype(); " id="""; node.id; """ isInFocusChain="; node.isInFocusChain(); " hasFocus="; node.hasFocus(); ">" for i=0 to node.getChildCount()-1 printFocusTree(node.getChild(i), level+1) end for End Function
